title: Recovery 2.6 - jumpers that may come off before the 3.3.35 boot
caption: Candidates only: the jumpers that connect the LaunchPad's LEDs and sensors to the CC3220's pins. Which ones come off follows from the pin map of the firmware image (to be done); until then, all stay.

callouts.label: LEDs D8-D10 to the CC3220
callouts.note: 'LED EN' and 'J24' printed by the header, and beside it 'D10 → P64', 'D9 → P01', 'D8 → ...' (D8's pin is hidden under the cap in the photo). Identity from the silkscreen. Whether it comes off: guess, it follows from the pin map (do the 3.3.35 image's pins P64/P01/P02 drive something else?).

callouts.label: Sensor I2C jumpers
callouts.note: 'J15' and 'J16' printed right of the header, '(SCL)' above it and '(SDA)' below, 'SENSORS' further up; one box for both, the photo is too soft here to split the two caps reliably. They link the on-board sensors (U10 'TEMP', U11) to the CC3220's I2C pins (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified). Whether they come off: guess, per the pin map.

callouts.label: Op-amp U9 enable
callouts.note: 'OPAMP EN' printed under it and 'J14' beside it; U9 'BB OPA 4342EA' sits just below. What it connects to which CC3220 pins: SWRU463 not checked (unverified). Whether it comes off: guess, per the pin map.

callouts.label: Reset pull-up
callouts.note: 'RST PU' printed above it and 'J9' beside it: by its name a pull-up on the reset line, not a peripheral (unverified). Listed for completeness; likely stays on (guess).
